description:
C3 (additive): one 2D technical drawing sheet of a version — GET /projects/{id}/drawings?version=n (CAD_DRAWINGS=1).
Orthographic views (first angle) + isometric, dimensions measured on the STEP, ISO 2768-m title block.

sheet.description: Sheet id within the version: 'A1' assembly, 'P01'… parts, 'M01'… moulded shells (DFM model)
sheet.title: Sheet

part_id.description: GLB part_id (PartMeta.part_id) drawn on a part sheet; None on the assembly
part_id.title: Part Id

set_pdf_url.description: /files/<pid>/drawings/v<n>_set.pdf — every sheet of the version, one PDF
set_pdf_url.title: Set Pdf Url

scale.description: Scale of the orthographic views, ISO 5455 standard, e.g. '1:2'
scale.title: Scale

bbox_mm.description: Overall [x, y, z] measured on the STEP (Z up)
bbox_mm.title: Bbox Mm

note.const: Generated from CAD — verify before release
note.default: Generated from CAD — verify before release
note.title: Note

title: DrawingSheet
